channel.title: govbot — Police District Councils: candidates on upcoming ballots
channel.description: All Police District Councils races govbot is tracking on upcoming Chicago/Illinois ballots, refreshed twice daily.

item.title: Police District Councilmember — Police District 001
item.description: On the ballot 2027-02-23. No candidates confirmed yet. One of three seats on the elected Police District Council for this Chicago police district. District Councils shape local policing priorities and help pick the citywide Community Commission. On the 2027 Chicago municipal ballot.
